ThingDef.label: button mushroom cluster
ThingDef.description: A cluster of button mushrooms grown in soil or a hydroponics basin. Grows normally at light levels up to 50%. Stronger light gradually slows growth to 50% speed at 100% light, without direct light damage. Can be sown in growing zones and hydroponics basins. Native hydroponics power requirements apply. Wild ecology: Most likely to appear during autumn. Seasonal emergence does not change cultivated growth. May form a small fairy ring. After harvesting in the wild, surviving mycelium has a 30% chance to fruit again after 6 days if the site remains suitable.

ThingDef.label: assorted mushrooms
ThingDef.description: Sow one of eleven cultivated mushroom varieties at random in growing zones or hydroponics basins, each with an equal chance. Includes cauliflower and purple blewit; excludes matsutake and wild enoki. Each new sowing picks again. The chosen variety keeps its own growth, harvest and food effects. Requires Plants skill 6. Native hydroponics power requirements apply.
